generate_h2_header_frame: generate an HPACK-encoded HTTP/2 header frame from colon-separated headers read from stdin
append_never_indexed_header: append a never-indexed HPACK header entry with key and value to a payload line
append_inc_indexed_header: append an incremental-indexed HPACK header entry with key and value to a payload line
append_pre_indexed_header: append a pre-indexed HPACK header entry using the static table index to a payload line
escape_bytes_for_c: escape binary payload bytes into a C-compatible string literal with hex escapes
